text: # Synthetic operational record N41 [N41-01] Release N41-R1 occurred on 20 September at 10:00. Ada signed as north-operator with an active credential. Devon signed approval at 09:00 under his N41-through-N50 delegation effective 18 through 25 September. The unrevoked node permit covered 20 September. Approval and permit histories are complete for this interval. The node number and approval date both fall within delegated scope. The record therefore meets the ordinary revision B route. Devon's signature must not be generalized to nodes outside that explicit range. [N41-02] Bundle receipt. This node belongs to rack 5, monitoring segment S5. The named handoff transferred configuration bundle sequence 1041, checksum label L3041, to node N41. The receipt confirms bundle identity and administrative handoff, not all future service behavior. It does not independently establish complete event history outside the stated interval.
